description: This file contains integration tests for the UserController in an ASP.NET Core web application. It uses Xunit for testing and sets up a web application factory with custom authentication schemes to verify user authentication behavior.

classes.name: UserControllerTests
classes.description: Contains integration tests for the UserController, verifying behaviors for authenticated and anonymous user scenarios.

classes.name: TestAuthHandlerOptions
classes.description: Authentication scheme options class for the fake auth handler.

classes.name: TestAuthHandler
classes.description: Custom authentication handler that simulates an authenticated user for testing purposes.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the WebApplicationFactory with custom configuration.
